verdict.rationale: Riveter is a web scraping and enrichment API, so a marketplace of ready-made scrapers is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence never mentions a marketplace, store, or library of prebuilt scrapers. It describes only prompt-driven enrichments, a generic scrape endpoint, and AI agents that adapt to page redesigns, which are related features rather than marketplace scrapers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a ready-made scraper from a marketplace instead of building one from scratch
